content: Griseofulvin interacts with various drugs by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism, leading to changes in drug levels and effects. Below are the detailed interactions: 1. Etonogestrel: Griseofulvin reduces the levels or effects of etonogestrel by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Hormonal contraceptive efficacy may be reduced. Use a non-hormonal contraceptive method and monitor closely. 2. Etrasimod: Griseofulvin increases etrasimod levels or effects, especially in CYP2C9 poor metabolizers when combined with moderate to strong CYP2C8 inhibitors. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 3. Etravirine: Griseofulvin decreases etravirine levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 4. Eucalyptus: Griseofulvin reduces the levels or effects of eucalyptus through CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 5. Everolimus: Griseofulvin decreases everolimus levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 6. Exemestane: Griseofulvin reduces exemestane levels or effects through CYP3A4 metabolism. For patients on potent CYP3A4 inducers, the recommended exemestane dose is 50 mg daily after a meal. Monitor closely. 7. Felodipine: Griseofulvin decreases felodipine levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 8. Fesoterodine: Griseofulvin reduces fesoterodine levels or effects through CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 9. Finasteride: Griseofulvin decreases finasteride levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 10. Fludrocortisone: Griseofulvin reduces fludrocortisone levels or effects through CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 11. Food: Food increases griseofulvin levels by enhancing gastrointestinal absorption. This applies only to oral forms of both agents. 12. Fosamprenavir: Griseofulvin decreases fosamprenavir levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 13. Fosaprepitant: Griseofulvin reduces fosaprepitant levels or effects through CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 14. Hydrocortisone: Griseofulvin decreases hydrocortisone levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 15. Hydroxyprogesterone Caproate: Griseofulvin reduces hydroxyprogesterone caproate levels or effects through CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 16. Iloperidone: Griseofulvin decreases iloperidone levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 17. Imatinib: Griseofulvin reduces imatinib levels or effects through CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 18. Imipramine: Griseofulvin decreases imipramine levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 19. Indinavir: Griseofulvin reduces indinavir levels or effects through CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 20. Isradipine: Griseofulvin decreases isradipine levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 21. Itraconazole: Griseofulvin reduces itraconazole levels or effects through CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 22. Ixabepilone: Griseofulvin decreases ixabepilone levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 23. Ketoconazole: Griseofulvin reduces ketoconazole levels or effects through CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 24. Lapatinib: Griseofulvin decreases lapatinib levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 25. Levonorgestrel (Intrauterine and Oral): Griseofulvin reduces levonorgestrel levels or effects through CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Hormonal contraceptive efficacy may be reduced; consider alternative or backup contraception. 26. Linagliptin: Griseofulvin increases linagliptin levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Alternative treatments are strongly recommended. 27. Lopinavir: Griseofulvin decreases lopinavir levels or effects through CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 28. Loratadine: Griseofulvin reduces loratadine levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 29. Lovastatin: Griseofulvin decreases lovastatin levels or effects through CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 30. Lumefantrine: Griseofulvin reduces lumefantrine levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 31. Maraviroc: Griseofulvin decreases maraviroc levels or effects through CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 32. Mesalamine: Griseofulvin reduces mesalamine levels by an unknown mechanism. Use caution and monitor closely. 33. Mestranol: Griseofulvin decreases mestranol levels or effects through CYP3A4 metabolism, potentially causing menstrual irregularities. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 34. Methadone: Griseofulvin reduces methadone levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 35. Methoxsalen: Griseofulvin and methoxsalen may increase each other's toxicity through pharmacodynamic synergism, leading to additive photosensitizing effects. Use caution and monitor closely. 36. Methyl Aminolevulinate: Griseofulvin and methyl aminolevulinate may increase each other's toxicity through pharmacodynamic synergism, enhancing photosensitizing effects. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 37. Methylprednisolone: Griseofulvin reduces methylprednisolone levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 38. Midazolam: Griseofulvin decreases midazolam levels or effects through CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 39. Montelukast: Griseofulvin reduces montelukast levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 40. Nelfinavir: Griseofulvin decreases nelfinavir levels or effects through CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 41. Nicardipine: Griseofulvin reduces nicardipine levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 42. Nifedipine: Griseofulvin decreases nifedipine levels or effects through CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 43. Nilotinib: Griseofulvin reduces nilotinib levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 44. Nimodipine: Griseofulvin decreases nimodipine levels or effects through CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 45. Nisoldipine: Griseofulvin reduces nisoldipine levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 46. Nitrendipine: Griseofulvin decreases nitrendipine levels or effects through CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 47. Ondansetron: Griseofulvin reduces ondansetron levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 48. Oxybutynin: Griseofulvin decreases oxybutynin levels or effects through CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 49. Paclitaxel: Griseofulvin may either increase or decrease paclitaxel levels depending on the mechanism. Use caution and monitor closely. 50. Pacritinib: Griseofulvin reduces pacritinib levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 51. Parecoxib: Griseofulvin decreases parecoxib levels or effects through CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 52. Pazopanib: Griseofulvin reduces pazopanib levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 53. Pegvaliase: Griseofulvin may interact with pegvaliase, especially in patients developing anti-PEG antibodies. Monitor closely and check drug labels for PEG content. 54. Pentobarbital: Pentobarbital reduces griseofulvin levels by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This applies only to oral forms. 55. Phenobarbital: Phenobarbital decreases griseofulvin levels by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This applies only to oral forms. 56. Pimozide: Griseofulvin reduces pimozide levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 57. Pioglitazone: Griseofulvin decreases pioglitazone levels or effects through CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 58. Porfimer: Griseofulvin and porfimer may enhance photosensitivity through pharmacodynamic synergism. Use caution and monitor closely. 59. Prednisone: Griseofulvin reduces prednisone levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 60. Primidone: Primidone decreases griseofulvin levels by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This applies only to oral forms. 61. Propafenone: Griseofulvin reduces propafenone levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 62. Quetiapine: Griseofulvin decreases quetiapine levels or effects through CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 63. Quinidine: Griseofulvin reduces quinidine levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 64. Quinine: Griseofulvin decreases quinine levels or effects through CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 65. Ramelteon: Griseofulvin reduces ramelteon levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 66. Ranolazine: Griseofulvin decreases ranolazine levels or effects through CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 67. Repaglinide: Griseofulvin reduces repaglinide levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 68. Resmetirom: Griseofulvin increases resmetirom levels or effects by decreasing metabolism. Adjust therapy and monitor closely. 69. Ritonavir: Griseofulvin reduces ritonavir levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 70. Romidepsin: Griseofulvin decreases romidepsin levels or effects through CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 71. Saccharomyces boulardii: Griseofulvin reduces the effects of Saccharomyces boulardii by an unspecified mechanism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 72. Salicylates (Non-ASA): Griseofulvin decreases salicylate levels by an unknown mechanism. Use caution and monitor closely. 73. Salsalate: Griseofulvin reduces salsalate levels by an unknown mechanism. Use caution and monitor closely. 74. Saxagliptin: Griseofulvin decreases saxagliptin levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance of this interaction is unknown. 75. Selexipag: Griseofulvin increases selexipag levels or effects by decreasing metabolism. Adjust therapy and monitor closely. 76. Sildenafil: Griseofulvin reduces sildenafil levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. This list highlights the importance of monitoring and adjusting therapy when griseofulvin is co-administered with other drugs.
